files.README.md:
# Rivermouth Freight - Sable Terminal stock control

stock_scan.tsv is the terminal's stock count feed for the round. It
carries one line per item held at the terminal and gives the units
counted on the floor.

reorder_plan.csv gives the reorder point the planning desk keeps for each
catalogue number; unit_costs.csv gives the standard cost per unit.

An item is below its reorder point when the counted units are under that
point. The value of an item's stock is its counted units multiplied by
the standard cost.

turns.prompt: Rivermouth Freight is closing the month at the Sable Terminal. The scanner feed stock_scan.tsv, the reorder plan reorder_plan.csv and the standard cost list unit_costs.csv are in the workspace. What is the total value of the stock held for the items whose shelf count came in under their reorder point? Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
